controls: Canonical GeoJSON must bind path, regular-file type, size, SHA-256 and Git blob in one start/end-stable receipt.
Top-level GeoJSON type must be exactly FeatureCollection with one features array and no duplicate critical keys.
Canonical source must be valid UTF-8 and reject BOM ambiguity, NUL bytes and invalid control characters.
Streaming parser must reject duplicate object keys for top-level, feature, geometry and properties objects.
Per-feature object byte size must remain within a bounded limit and emit heartbeat before any long parse.
After the features array closes, only valid remaining JSON members and whitespace may occur; trailing garbage blocks.
A deterministic independent count must agree with the streaming 92283-feature count before candidate extraction.
Target ordinals must explicitly use one-based feature order and reject zero-based or row-property substitution.
Each target security_parcel_id must be globally unique across the complete canonical collection.
Target Point coordinates must contain exactly two finite numeric values with no altitude or measure dimension.
GeoJSON coordinate semantics must be explicitly WGS84 longitude-latitude and reject conflicting legacy crs members.
Each extracted target point must publish a canonical row/parcel/coordinate hash used by all later joins.
Chunk size must parse as a strict bounded positive integer and not permit pathological memory or one-byte scans.
Features-array discovery must prove the token is a top-level member rather than bytes inside a string value.
Streaming object framing requires fixtures for escaped quotes, Unicode escapes and nested objects or arrays.
Candidate output must use same-volume temporary write, flush and atomic replace with final SHA receipt.
Canonical and evidence inputs must retain size, mtime and SHA from scan start through output publication.
Point and HMLR seed evidence must bind exact slot, task, attempt, continuation and current run_id.
Seed HMLR areas must be finite, positive and below a documented plausible upper bound.
Any extractor exception must quarantine prior latest output and publish a deterministic blocked receipt with zero rows.
